text.tspan: Death rate from diarrheal disease in children vs. access to basic
Estimated annual number of deaths from diarrheal diseases per 100,000 children under five, versus the percentage of
people with access to basic handwashing facilities, including soap and water.
Share of the population with basic handwashing facilities
Diarrheal diseases death rate in children (deaths per 100,000 people; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: IHME, Global Burden of Disease (2025); WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene
